testScenarios.subCategory: RGB_Stress/Teams call with all MEP enable in battery mode

testScenarios.objective: Make a teams call with all MEP features offloaded in battery drain mode for at least 60 min
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Turn on all camera and audio effects: Background blur, Eye contact. Auto framing and Voice Focus (if available)
2. Start a Teams Video call or host a meeting with all MEP effects on and NPU loading is non-zero. 
3. Share the screen and start recording in video call, make sure all the enabled MEP effects work as expected without display corruption,  or system freeze.
4. Plug in Type C external monitor make sure display no corruption and effects still works as expected while toggle to different project mode including PC only, Duplicate, Extend, Second screen only.
5. Start an online video streaming such as YouTube video via Edge etc. and move the playback to external monitor
6. Continuing recording and sharing online video playback in Teams call, test at least 60 mins
7. Completed step 1 ~5, let system goes to CS, S4, Reboot and shutdown, try to launch call with MEP again  and make sure MEP effect still works.
Report issue if you see any display corruption, system abnormal or performance concern.and RFC)

testScenarios.detailedSteps: Log in as a standard user. For FFc and RFC, navigate to Camera Settings . Go to Advanced settings and enable

(This is enabling Auto-Share Mode)
a) Launch camera apps that support sharing mode : Teams FFC video call, CameraApp in FFC,  Manage Camera in FFC; 
b) Launch AmCap in FFC preview , 
c) Launch CaptureEngineInternal in FFC preview
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
1) Auto-Share Mode is enabled without requiring admin privileges, 
2) All camera app are able to concurrently stream video

testScenarios.testName: Verify camera controls in Auto-Share Mode

testScenarios.objective: Switch to video mode in FFC  in CameraAPp, check result; Switch to Photo Mode FFC in CamearApp
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
In CameraAPp, switch to Photo mode and check result; In CameraApp switch to video mode and check result
a) Launch camera apps that support sharing mode : CameraApp in FFC and Manage Camera in FFC 
b) Launch camera app that does not support sharing mode : AmCap in FFC preview 
c) Go to camera control settings for each app (ie: Control for Brightness, White Balange ..)
